description.value:
Frequency once per round; Trigger A creature you can see damages you.

Choose one — (a) gain resistance equal to twice your highest Depth against that damage, or (b) if the triggering creature is within your reach, make a Carapace Strike against it. It does not stack with Carapace Block against the same damage.

Target the creature that damaged you and use it as the damage is rolled. It asks which: (a) arms the plate for the next damage you take this round and is taken off it as it lands — with Carapace Block also armed, only the larger of the two applies; (b) makes the Carapace Strike, offered only while the creature is within your reach. While the symbiont is suppressed there is no Depth, so only (b) is offered.
